thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: realtime-watchdog: detected p95 anomaly for /stream/v2 — p95=2.1s (baseline 0.33s), p99=7.2s. Streaming stalls observed. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streams/stream-latency?from=now-15m

anna_oncall: Ack, I'm taking this. Paging SRE and Prod. Any recent config/deploy?

mike_prod: Canary for model-quant adjustments rolled ~18m ago. It did change streaming cache TTL and batching hints.

sre_lead: Pulling metrics. Quick checks: kvcache hit rate, evictions, inflight streams per GPU, nginx 504 rate. Can someone grep recent eviction spikes?

ops_bot: kvcache_hit_rate_last_5m=58% (was ~95%). kvcache_evictions spiked x9. inflight_streams_per_host subset 10.0.5.* = 240 -> 480. nginx_504_rate increased 3x.

julia_support: CS tickets 4412/4413 report frozen assistant UX and stream timeouts around the same window. Marking as potentially customer-impacting.

anna_oncall: Mike, did the canary change cache TTLs cluster-wide or only in canary pool?

mike_prod: It was supposed to be scoped to canary pool only, but config templating bug propagated TTL=30s to default profile. Rolling the canary back now (rollout r-2026-09-quant).

sre_lead: While rollback happens, mitigation plan: 1) shift new /stream/v2 traffic to fallback-pool (older model) 2) bump cache memory on hot hosts 3) emergency horizontal scale +2 replicas for streamer nodes. Execute in that order.

anna_oncall: Executing route change: `ri route set --service stream-v2 --policy fallback-pool --drain 20s`.

ops_bot: route update applied; ~45% traffic shifted to fallback. autoscaler requested +2 nodes in us-west-2-streamers; provisioning started.

sre_lead: Enable taillatency debug logs on hosts 10.0.5.* for next 20m: `rdctl logs --hosts 10.0.5.* --filter taillatency --level debug` — capture KV eviction traces.

anna_oncall: Observability update: nginx 504s trending down, p95 now 0.95s, p99 2.8s. Still above SLO but improving.

mike_prod: Rollback finished. Cache TTL restored to 300s for default profile. Eviction rate falling.

ops_bot: kvcache_hit_rate_last_5m=91%. inflight_streams_per_host normalized ~150. p95=0.42s p99=0.88s for /stream/v2.

sre_lead: Mitigations effective. Next steps: create incident ticket, schedule postmortem. Action items: add preflight to canary templating to prevent profile-wide TTL drift, add alert for eviction storm (evictions > 5x baseline), and add a check for TTL diff between canary and default.

julia_support: I'll update affected customers with resolution note and action items.

anna_oncall: Creating incident ticket INC-2026-881 and assigning owners for PM and SRE follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT 5306000123 status -> mitigated (monitoring). Duration ~72s. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/stream-eviction-canary
